sections.title: PURPOSE & SCOPE
sections.body:

**Scope limitation:** Internal comparative work only; no client, location, or external-party information is included in this archive copy.

**Method:** Coded materials or instruments were evaluated through a repeatable bench or field-support sequence appropriate to the stated objective. Observations were recorded at fixed checkpoints and reviewed against the applicable internal working range.

**Observations:** The comparison produced stable, ordinary results suitable for the stated disposition. No unexpected response was recorded.

sections.body:
